title: Matriarchy Classics: A Computational Approach to Swap Only Gendered Words in Classic Novels
abstract: arXiv:2611.07134v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper proposes a trustworthy computational method to gender-swap public domain novels, with programmatic guarantees that only gendered words are inverted and all other words are left unchanged. This may seem like a simple task, but both large language models and naive rule-based methods fail to complete it. The proposed method includes a custom whitespace-preserving tokenizer, gender-swap mappings across plural and possessive forms, pronoun handling, and a character renaming strategy. It shortens the time required to gender-swap a novel from weeks of manual labor to minutes. The method is demonstrated on two public-domain novels. Pride and Prejudice is transported to matriarchal Regency England, where inheritance flows through daughters, mothers rule the household, and a frantic Mr. Bennet is determined to secure advantageous marriages for his sons. translated_title: 母系经典：一种仅替换经典小说中性别词汇的计算方法
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种可信的计算方法，用于对公有领域小说进行性别转换，并通过程序化保证仅反转性别词汇，而所有其他词汇保持不变。这看似是一个简单的任务，但大型语言模型和朴素的基于规则的方法都无法完成。所提出的方法包括自定义的保留空白字符的分词器、覆盖复数和所有格形式的性别转换映射、代词处理以及角色重命名策略。该方法将一部小说的性别转换所需时间从数周的手工劳动缩短至几分钟。该方法在两部公有领域小说上进行了演示：《傲慢与偏见》被转换至母系的摄政时期英格兰，在那里遗产由女儿继承，母亲掌管家务，心急如焚的班纳特先生决心为儿子们谋得美满姻缘；《了不起的盖茨比》则转向母系的爵士时代，在那里新富的盖茨比夫人……
tldr: 本文提出一种可靠的计算方法，能在程序化保证其他文字不变的前提下仅替换小说中的性别词汇，将原本需数周的手工性别转换缩短至几分钟，并通过《傲慢与偏见》和《了不起的盖茨比》的母系改写版本加以演示。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a trustworthy computational method that swaps only gendered words in classic novels with programmatic guarantees, reducing weeks of manual labor to minutes, demonstrated through matriarchal adaptations of Pride and Prejudice and The Great Gatsby.
